idea-plugin.name: Light Code
idea-plugin.description:
A minimal agentic coding assistant, for working inside an organisation.
  • Light Code 0.139.0: new chat with a handoff; reads a program paused in VS Code's debugger.
  • Light Code 0.138.0: skills, tools and the standing instructions open in Light Code's own editor.
  • Light Code 0.137.0: replies copy with their formatting; Confluence pages are written from Markdown; links in a reply open in the default browser; AutoSys says the token needs only the consumer key and secret.
  • Light Code 0.136.0: every greyed-out button says why when hovered; AutoSys asks for username and password plainly.
  • Light Code 0.135.0: GitHub Copilot as a provider, through an open VS Code window with Light Code.
  • Light Code 0.134.0: the company-directory lookup no longer uses PowerShell; a second Fire Code chat no longer reports its scheduler as stopped.
  • Light Code 0.133.0: monthly roll-up of usage statistics.
  • Light Code 0.132.0: usage collection safe with several sessions at once; usage_stats tool for custom metrics.
  • Light Code 0.131.0: names from the company directory; leaderboard by written, impact or this period.
  • Light Code 0.130.1: help explains user-info tools for the usage dashboard.
  • Light Code 0.130.0: usage collected automatically, past chats imported, people shown by name and team.
  • Light Code 0.129.0: usage dashboard - most used skills, contributors, unused and duplicate skills and tools.
  • Light Code 0.128.0: large tool results read straight into dataframe; joins built in steps.
  • Light Code 0.127.0: dataframe joins SQLite, JSON and records from other tools.
  • Light Code 0.126.0: DFS shares used as written; content search across shares (Fire Code helper).
  • Light Code 0.125.1: the switch to the lighter prompt indexes tool documentation automatically.
  • Light Code 0.125.0: far less context used by tool descriptions when a search index is configured.
  • Light Code 0.124.0: a proxy (with login) for API calls; help knows the Rust tools.
  • Light Code 0.123.0: REST API calls (negotiate, Apigee, certificates), Python libraries in parallel, dataframe analysis.
  • Light Code 0.122.0: groundwork for Fire Code's SQLite reader.
  • Light Code 0.121.1: asking it to message someone in Teams sends the message.
  • Light Code 0.121.0: Teams can send a message when you ask; no server-only tabs on your own machine.
  • Light Code 0.120.0: merge an approved Bitbucket pull request and tag it; open a Teams chat with a message typed in for you to send.
  • Light Code 0.119.0: Bitbucket files can be read on sites behind single sign-on.
  • Light Code 0.118.1: a formatted answer no longer collapses into a paragraph as the reply ends.
  • Light Code 0.118.0: compaction only when you ask (or switch it on), your own messages kept word for word, hung replies and dropped connections retried.
  • Your own gateway: mutual TLS, client certificates, OAuth client-credentials, header auth.
  • An agent team — expert, programmer, reviewer, tester, librarian — each backed by a different model, consulting each other.
  • MCP tools, dynamic Python tools, skills shared across a team.
  • Technical diagrams, charts, and indexed search over your own data.
  • No telemetry, no default endpoints. Nothing is contacted that you did not configure.
Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm and the other IntelliJ-based IDEs.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Light Code 0.203.0: consult your organisation's web chat (such as Gemini) with ask_web_chat through your own Chrome DevTools MCP server - only the backend address you approve, a dedicated Chrome server you choose, works with chrome-devtools-mcp 1.x; choose per chat whether the decision model picks skills, tools or both; fixes for specialists keeping their context, AutoSys conditions, "only me" skills and tools in the Node host, and shorter paths on the startup bar.
  • Light Code 0.196.0: decision models such as D3 (asked on their own /v1/systemone API, endpoint configurable) - Agent team routing, strategy loop verdicts, decision steps and hand-over scores, an Anti Hallucinator first pass, and per-chat Picks of skills and/or tools; skills and Python tools load in one go and faster; suggestions while typing; AutoSys conditions read however the server shapes them; specialists keep their context through a reply; shorter paths on the startup bar.
  • Light Code 0.192.0: AutoSys run time and ETA, usual start time and recursive predecessors; + keeps the chat's strategy; a slow start no longer holds up the first reply, and the startup bar names the slow step.
  • Light Code 0.190.0: custom roles work with ask_agent and strategies; specialists hand over to each other directly so the main chat stays lean; a bar shows what a starting chat is waiting on; hand off automatically at the context limit; an option for no step limit.
  • Light Code 0.189.0: a strategy stays with its chat through reloads and restarts, a new chat starts with none, and every new topic follows the strategy with fresh loop rounds.
  • Light Code 0.188.0: Strategy boxes connect to steps and other boxes, with a new box for a group of steps done in order; @ files in a step's instructions; chats start answering without waiting for every MCP server.
  • Light Code 0.187.0: @ finds folders by name and searches inside a typed folder; a slow or unreliable network is retried instead of failing at once (a minute to connect, dropped connections and timeouts tried again); the first reply of a chat no longer waits for Python tools, skills and the gateway sign-in one after another.
  • Light Code 0.185.0: Google Gemini's model list loads before a model is chosen and shows newer models such as Gemini 4; Gemini no longer refuses tool schemas over propertyNames; spent API credit is reported at once instead of retried.
  • Light Code 0.144.0: Set up SSH key on the Linux add-on's tab; an add-on tab lists its tools.
  • Light Code 0.143.0: add-ons can bring their own settings tab; the Linux add-on (SSH, read-only commands, downloads).
  • Light Code 0.142.0: a chat page loaded twice no longer stops on "That link has already been used".
  • Light Code 0.141.0: .hubignore for JupyterHub codebases (no change in the IDE).
  • Light Code 0.140.0: add-ons (extra tools from Node packages you install), codebase instructions, and about 130 MB less memory for the Light Code process.
  • Light Code 0.117.0: drafts kept, compaction at the token limit, Excel recalculation, tinted code blocks, dropped files and Outlook emails read in place, email attachments read.
  • Light Code 0.116.0: Fire Code's fast file tools are introduced to the agent (no change in the IDE).
  • Light Code 0.115.0: Python tools reading saved credentials safely; identical tools approved once (Fire Code).
  • Light Code 0.114.0: JupyterHub codebases for Fire Code (no change in the IDE).
  • Light Code 0.113.0: the @ picker says when nothing matches.
  • Light Code 0.112.0: @codebase-name on its own, a saved credential for a search connection's username, full names on hover in dropdowns.
  • Light Code 0.111.0: the handbook covers Fire Code (formerly Sun Code).
  • Light Code 0.110.0: a config saved with a byte-order mark is read; a shell command naming a file changed since it was read waits for a re-read.
  • Light Code 0.109.0: @ always finds the file you mean in a large codebase; the handbook covers Fire Code's schedule timetable.
  • Light Code 0.108.0: code in chat is highlighted again, in VS Code's colours; notify can attach a report file (.md or .html); white text on teal accents; a Review icon of its own.
  • Light Code 0.107.0: after every edit the assistant sees the errors and warnings its change produced, from language servers installed on this machine (Python, Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, Go and more), and a get_diagnostics tool checks any file without a build; an edit made from a stale read is refused; rollback keeps line endings exactly.
  • Light Code 0.106.0: the handbook covers Fire Code's reach and parallel file tools.
  • Light Code 0.105.0: your keys can be brought into Fire Code with its "From IntelliJ / PyCharm" button; the Variables tab shows only your own variables; the handbook explains Fire Code, the new Windows app for several codebases at once; a secrets file shared by several processes no longer loses a key.
  • Light Code 0.101.0: Outlook waits out a busy Outlook instead of failing, recovers from a hung request, and finds old mail by date range.
  • Light Code now comes inside the plugin: every feature and fix of the matching VS Code and Node releases, with no npm download. Needs Node.js 18 or newer on the PATH.
  • New in Light Code: reply to a message or react to it and to its thinking; a wait tool for following a job or build until it is done; AutoSys status and details for many jobs at once; AutoSys through an API gateway, with a username and password where the gateway needs them.
  • No deprecated platform APIs (process listening uses ProcessListener).
  • The Light Code icon in the Marketplace, the plugin list and the tool window.
  • Installs into every IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm release from 2023.2 on; 0.1.0 refused anything newer than 2025.1.
